name: Crude Tattoo, Baneful Slayer
body:
Aura faint necromancy, evocation; CL 3rd; Slot –; Price 1,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This crude tattoo features the severed head of a creature chosen at the tattoo’s crafting.

EFFECT

Keyed to a specific creature type chosen at the tattoo’s creation, a baneful slayer crude tattoo empowers the bearer’s combat capabilities as they slay creatures of that type. Whenever the bearer kills a creature of the chosen type, the tattoo grants a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and DCs against creatures of that type; these bonuses can only stack to a total of +2 and last for one minute.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells hunter’s howl; Special Creator must possess the favored enemy class ability, Profession (calligraphy artist, painter, or tattoo artist) 3 ranks; Cost 500 gp
